# Installed-font tracking origins

Original OOXML generated by `tools/installed_tracking_origins_fixture.py` under
the repository license. No font programs or template artwork are included.
27 pages / 162 paragraphs use regular Garamond, Arial and Times New Roman,
12/17/28 points, tracking 0/+0.75/-0.5 points, no kerning or ligatures.

Native page metafiles were captured read-only from an unchanged owned scratch
copy in the reference application. The recorder verifies geometry, hashes, text, and the
actual font descriptors before accepting the origin data. Availability alone
does not prove the painted font. `source-close.json` confirms that the exact
unchanged scratch copy was closed without saving.

The browser probe calls the production text painter and reconstructs its full
string masks at prefix/suffix position candidates. Every accepted candidate must
match all alpha pixels. This validates origins for these controls, not general
shaping or native raster fidelity. One Times New Roman line requires the prefix
candidate; a universally valid suffix method is not established.

The existing 0.2-point native-origin bound remains unchanged. A 28-point,
untracked Garamond row of 16 M characters exceeds it at 0.214672 points and is
recorded as an expected failure. Do not promote corpus documents or claim full font
equivalence from the remaining passing cases.
